name: J0840-0529 (Webb)
blurb: J0840-0529, a dual quasar, seen by Webb.
label: gmpj08400529-webb
story: Two active galactic nuclei shine here, less than an arcsecond apart. Gaia first hinted at the pair, and spectra showed two distinct glowing cores rather than a single lensed one.

claims.text: J0840-0529 is a dual AGN (two distinct quasars), not a lensed quasar
The two components are separated by 0.385 arcseconds
It was selected with the Gaia Multi Peak (GMP) technique
MUSE adaptive-optics spectroscopy confirmed dual AGN among Gaia Multi Peak candidates
